grh_065bce2ab2818aa29a71.title: Butch Minds the Baby
paragraphs: Paroled safecracker Big Butch is trying to stay straight when gangster Harry the Horse recruits him for one more job. Butch agrees only because widowed Susie O'Neill and her baby Michael desperately need money, and the robbery becomes farcical when he has to mind the baby at the same time. After the safe is blown, Butch tries to return a stolen check so its owner will avoid tax trouble and so Michael can win a promised baby-contest prize. His parole officer discovers the scheme, but recognizes that Butch's motive was to help Susie rather than enrich himself. Butch still expects to answer for the crime, yet walks away feeling that for once he has come out on top by doing something for someone else.
